name: List of Coptic Biblical Manuscripts (LCBM) Version 1.0
description: The List of Coptic Biblical Manuscripts (LCBM) is a common list of Coptic biblical manuscripts maintained and regularly updated by the INTF Münster (Siegfried G. Richter and Katharina Schröder) and the Coptic Old Testament project at the Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities. It was the result of an agreement between Siegfried Richter and Frank Feder in 2016 to replace the partly overlapping and competing numbering systems of Karlheinz Schüssler's Biblia Coptica and the SMR (Schmitz-Mink-Richter) list of Coptic New Testament manuscripts. The details are outlined in an article in the Journal of Coptic Studies 22.
